caption:
Figure 1: PITCH (Proactive Intervention Timing in CHat) is the first benchmark for proactive inter-
vention timing built from unscripted human conversations and participants’ own judgments of when
proactive interjections should occur. We collected the benchmark data via a four-phrase protocol:
Conversation, Message Contribution, Timing Judgments, and Deliberation. We then evaluated 15
models across 28 configurations against the benchmark in three task setups that differ in their task
difficulty and realism for real-world deployment of agents in group conversations.
delegated_acceptance_review: Actually viewed the final PITCH figure and read its source caption plus all independent source-pair observations. Four original collection phases, the Waymo source search and candidate message, participant conversation, timing window Turn 6-11/best 8, and deliberation are intact. Tasks A/B/C retain replay, 5-turn lookahead, and full-transcript setups, selected turns and upward realism/difficulty arrow. The added overall benchmark bridge and 15-model/28-configuration heading are directly supported by the caption. All five protected source blocks are replayed at 2x nearest-neighbor. No new empirical result or participant judgment is introduced.
